explication: This Terraform module provisions Google Cloud Armor security policies. A caller supplies policy settings and rule maps; the root module represents the global backend-policy workflow, while documented submodules cover regional backend policies and network-edge protection, including advanced network DDoS protection. The README documents the rule categories and supported load-balancer contexts, but no source excerpts were provided, so relationships are limited to those documented there.
